data.content_ref: inline:05a4074c795b shares mechanism with SRC_005: both treat finite induced stable cycles as the only obstructions, but 05a4074c795b adds a cutoff showing cycles longer than girth O(log n) have negligible basin, sharpening the Poisson count. Refuted if long induced cycles or non-cycle single-edge cuts carry non-vanishing basin mass, or if the expected number of stable cycles diverges with n.
